responsibility: This file implements builtin-function support for libgccjit. It reads GCC’s builtin definitions and attribute tables, resolves builtin names or IDs, lazily creates and caches corresponding recording::function objects and recording::function_type/type objects, translates builtin type signatures and builtin attributes into libgccjit recording and GCC tree forms, and prepares required builtins for optimization playback. It is the module that maps GCC’s builtins.def/builtin-attrs.def world into the JIT recording/playback machinery.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/jit-builtins.h, which declares the builtin-support types and builtins_manager interface, this same-stem source file provides the implementation that scans builtin definitions, constructs and caches builtin recording objects and types, and materializes builtin attributes for playback.
